# Set up your meeting types

## Description

Organizes calls with the notetaker's built in All, My, and Shared views so downstream summaries and reporting pull from the right call set.

## Steps

### Step 1: Audit the types you have

List the current meeting types in meeting types. For each existing type, classify it as KEEP (clearly defined, distinct purpose, sufficient volume to justify it), MERGE (overlaps with another type, for example a product walkthrough and a demo), RETIRE (no meetings booked in 90 d), or RENAME (purpose is right but the name is unclear).

### Step 2: Create the Discovery type

Create or update the 'Discovery' meeting type unless the audit in "Audit the types you have" shows a clean equivalent already exists. Set default duration to 30 min. Set booking link visibility to prospects in prospect stage who have not yet seen a demo. Set required outcome on completion: champion identified, pain confirmed, current solution noted, timeline established, budget signal captured. Set default notetaker autojoin to True on notetaker.

### Step 3: Create the Demo type

Create or update the 'Demo' meeting type unless a clean equivalent exists per "Audit the types you have". Set default duration to 45 min. Set booking link visibility to prospects in prospect stage who have completed discovery or self-served past the qualifying threshold. Set required outcome on completion: features demonstrated logged, technical questions captured, objections logged, next step proposed. Set default notetaker autojoin to True on notetaker. Use the results of "Audit the types you have" and "Create the Discovery type".

### Step 4: Create the Proposal type

Create or update the 'Proposal' meeting type. Set default duration to 30 min. Set booking link visibility to opportunities in prospect stage at proposal stage. Set required outcome on completion: pricing structure confirmed, contract questions captured, decision-maker presence verified, expected close date noted. Set default notetaker autojoin to True on notetaker. Use the results of "Audit the types you have" and "Create the Demo type".

### Step 5: Create the Renewal type

Create or update the 'Renewal' meeting type. Set default duration to 30 min. Set booking link visibility to existing customers in customer status whose contract end falls within 90 d. Set required outcome on completion: usage health confirmed, stakeholder confirmation, expansion or contraction signals, contract terms discussed. Set default notetaker autojoin to True on notetaker. Use the results of "Audit the types you have" and "Create the Proposal type".

### Step 6: Create the Check-in type

Create or update the 'Customer Success Check-in' meeting type. Set default duration to 30 min. Set booking link visibility to existing customers in customer status and make it reachable from help center. Set required outcome on completion: usage patterns discussed, blockers captured, expansion opportunities noted. Set default notetaker autojoin to True on notetaker. Use the results of "Audit the types you have" and "Create the Renewal type".
